name: save-boot-16-mds7-talk-off
description: #168 fresh budget, attempt 2 (diagnostic). Boot harness/saves/disc1-mds7.json (field 151, a #99 boot point where the pad moves the player) and load as save-boot-1-load does, then 60 still frames. Reports the field's model count (cnt) and TalkOff of models 1-6 (off1..off6: 0 = the model can be talked to; a model index at or above cnt is not a model). Only the count, these flag bytes and load_done leave.
